identity.name: SEOSONA
identity.logoPolicy: Use the intact source asset. Never generate, recolor, crop, outline, or replace it with a wordmark.

rules.headline: Weight 800 or 900, sentence case, tight line height, maximum four lines on square social slides.
rules.label: Weight 600 or 700, uppercase, expanded tracking.
rules.body: Weight 500, concise, never a paragraph wall.
rules.data: Labels at weight 600; verified numbers may use 700 or 800.

socialSquare.footer: SEOSONA · Share to be shared more

rules: at most one pale-blue emphasized phrase

componentRules.cover_dark: Cobalt hero with one claim, brief support line, and one CTA.
componentRules.explain_light: Kicker, large title, underline, and up to three proof cards.
componentRules.numbered_principle: Oversized two-digit index, one principle, evidence card, and optional cobalt takeaway strip.
componentRules.process_steps: Three to seven ordered steps with compact numbered markers.
componentRules.data_table: Honest before-after or categorized data; status colors describe verified state only.
componentRules.comparison_split: Two controlled panels separated by one VS token.
componentRules.proof_cards: One to three concise cards with evidence references.
componentRules.mascot_callout: One approved pose used as an explanatory accent or CTA anchor.

negativeRules: Do not render Vietnamese or Latin copy inside Flow-generated imagery.
Do not generate logos, wordmarks, or logo lookalikes.
Do not generate statistics, citations, or UI labels.
Do not use Chí Quyết Academy logos, mascots, coral palette, or copy style.
Do not use #E2724D, broad green panels, cyan neon, purple gradients, cyberpunk, or generic dark dashboards.
Do not use Poppins, Inter, Druk, Anton, or AI-generated font substitutes.
Do not fabricate claims, proof, sources, or status colors.
Do not place the mascot on every slide or use it as the primary logo.
